decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer sits close to the core coding offer and was launched only in 2018, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results mature.

The numbering software module is a low-cost extension of the existing digital printing portfolio that supports the firm's serialization strategy, so dropping it would release few resources and is not justified by any performance problem.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds on established ink expertise and serves customer demand for marking varied surfaces, and with no evidence of underperformance no problemistic search is triggered.
